title: 航空工学演習
subtitle: Aircraft Engineering Exercises
educationalGoal: Aircraft Engineering Exercises makes full use of the various knowledge that students have learned, and it is important to apply this knowledge by performing basic design of aircraft on a team and learn the importance of team activities in aircraft design.
advice: Each student team will perform the basic tasks of designing one aircraft. First, each team will aim to design a bestseller, determine the operational goals and performance of the aircraft, and outline the aircraft shape and flight control to satisfy these requirements. Next, the team will estimate the aerodynamics from the airframe shape, the flight performance, the stability, and the maneuverability, and evaluate flight performance using a flight simulator, and then complete the basic design. As a result of the above, each team will experience actual aircraft development, such as making presentations for airlines in a timely manner and making incremental improvements.
requiredKnowledge: Students need to make full use of all the knowledge they have learned, so must review everything studied up to this point.
